bindings.rationale: Node c3 describes the observed package-bound workflow resolution. If that resolved component/dependency graph changes, its physical-evidence backing is stale until rechecked. The safe-default claim c6 is intentionally not bound here because the agreed conan.lock reference state has not yet been implemented upstream.

semantics: Bindings do not make factual dependency edges into argument relations. They only record which authored argument nodes rely on a particular factual substrate so Horn can report staleness when that substrate changes.
